comments.author: @HiddenTravels98
comments.text: Those red crabs are so brave. I had no idea there were that many of them🤣🤣

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It really is unbelievable to witness tens of millions of them taking over the roads and forests, @HiddenTravels98! Their determination during migration season is nothing short of incredible. Thanks for watching and sharing your thoughts! 🦀

comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: I keep wondering what daily life looks like when the cameras are gone and crab season is at its absolute peak.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: It must be quite chaotic but fascinating to navigate, @LifewaysTravel! Imagine having to sweep crabs away just to open your front door—it’s a side of life there that most people can't even fathom.
